subject: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Comprehensive Permit
overview: The Zoning Board of Appeals met to consider a Chapter 40B comprehensive permit application for a 350-unit residential development at 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway and voted to continue the hearing to May 15, 2023.

items.title: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Comprehensive Permit
items.summary: The board granted the applicant's request to continue the Chapter 40B comprehensive permit hearing for a proposed 350-unit multifamily development at 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway to May 15, 2023.
